IDH1 Mutation; IDH2 Mutation; Recurrent Glioblastoma; Recurrent WHO Grade II Glioma; Recurrent WHO Grade III Glioma

candidate_evidence.quote: Determine the safety and tolerability of the combination of PARP inhibitor BGB-290 (BGB-290) and temozolomide (TMZ) in patients with recurrent IDH1/2 mutant glioma

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Phase I/II Study of BGB-290 With Temozolomide in Recurrent Gliomas With IDH1/2 Mutations

role_evidence.quote: Any DLT must be a toxicity considered at least possibly related to pamiparib (BGB-290) or TMZ.
BGB-290 may stop the growth of tumor cells by blocking some of the enzymes needed for cell growth.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: BGB-290 may stop the growth of tumor cells by blocking some of the enzymes needed for cell growth.

role_evidence.quote: OUTLINE: This is a phase I, dose de-escalation study of temozolomide followed by a phase II study.
BGB290 + TMZ at dose combination established in Phase 1

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, given in every arm (low-dose continuous schedule)

source_quote.quote: IDH1/2 mutations must be associated with neomorphic activity of the encoded proteins (i.e. IDH1 R132, IDH2 R172, IDH2 R140, IDH1 R100, IDH1 G97, IDH1 Y139).

flag.reason: IDH-mutant selection for a PARP inhibitor implies an IDH-mutation/PARP-sensitivity rationale, but the record does not state the mechanistic link.

source_quote.quote: Patients must have documented molecular 1p/19q and MGMT testing.
Patients must have documented molecular 1p/19q and MGMT testing.
Quantify 2-hydroxyglutarate (2HG) in archival formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) specimens via liquid chromatography mass spectrometry (LC-MS) detection and correlate with treatment response.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: tumour PARylation and BGB-290 tissue levels

source_quote.quote: Assess tumor tissue BGB-290 levels, 2HG, and PolyADP-ribosylation (PARylation) in a patient subset treated with drug prior to re-resection.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: whole-exome sequencing, RNA-seq and methylation profiling

source_quote.quote: Correlate response with 2HG levels, somatic alterations, gene expression/methylation patterns in FFPE tumor tissue.

coder_notes: All patients must have IDH1/2-mutant glioma, including the exploratory 'GBM Arm' (WHO grade IV); under CNS5 these are IDH-mutant astrocytoma grade 4, so not_glioblastoma per manual 1.1 note, despite 'Recurrent Glioblastoma' in conditions. cns5_terminology historical because IDH-mutant glioblastoma (WHO grade IV) is allowed. Temozolomide is in every arm (C3) so coded soc_backbone, although its schedule is de-escalated in phase I; an adjudicator could view it as experimental_combination. Pamiparib name taken from outcomes. MGMT and 1p/19q testing is required for entry but no status is required, so not coded as eligibility. BeiGene is a collaborator (captured by [CODE]); no text on drug supply.
